title: eng-releases
text:
eng-releases

mike: Kicking off fractional rollout to EU (v2.3.1) — aiming for 10% traffic. starting now. /deploybot start --percent=10 --region=eu-west-1 --version=v2.3.1

deploy-bot: Started staged rollout (id=1791112222) -> v2.3.1 · target 10% · regions: eu-west-1 · monitors: ops-dash · notify: #eng-releases

dana: seeing a small spike in 5xxs from eu-west around 14:22 UTC. running a quick query to confirm

leo: can we slow to 5% first? want to confirm kv-cache warmup + prefix caching behavior on 2.3.1

mike: @leo good call. hold for ops signal; i'm fine stepping down to 5% if metrics look noisy

sre-oncall: Telemetry snapshot: p90 latency eu-west increased 180ms -> 320ms in last 5m, 5xx rate from 0.7% -> 2.8% (3m window). flagging :warning:

irene: QA: I reproduced an NPE in embeddings preproc on v2.3.1 with long prompt (sample id 992). stack: `NullPointer at Preproc.java:112`

dana: logs: https://logs.re/redwood/abc123 — search ids 987, 992. error traces show `embeddingPreprocessor` failure on some user inputs

eva: release notes? we introduced a small schema tweak to embedded payloads in v2.3.1 — need to call it out if we rollback/patch

leo: vote: pause rollout + rollback eu region to v2.3.0. prefer targeted rollback vs global stop

eva: vote: rollback eu. want QA to sign off before any re-rollout

mike: leaning rollback for eu only. is infra comfortable with targeted region rollback?

sre-oncall: recommend rollback for eu-west-1 only. we don't see signal in other regions yet. ops says rollback-eu is lowest risk

mike: ok executing targeted rollback. running command:
```
/deploybot rollback --region=eu-west-1 --to-version=v2.3.0 --reason="elevated 5xx + NPEs" --thread=1791112222
```

deploy-bot: Rolling back eu-west-1 -> v2.3.0. initiating drain + cutover. ETA ~2m for traffic shift. Notifying monitors

dana: will watch logs and telemetry during cutover. posting quick query for post-rollback baseline

leo: after rollback completes, propose a slow canary: 5% with kv_cache disabled (`kv_cache=false`) and expanded eval set for embedding patterns

eva: i'll update release notes and create patch branch for embedding preproc fix. creating ticket: RTM-4321 and linking here

dana: rollback complete — eu-west traffic back to v2.3.0; 5xxs returned to baseline, p90 latency normalized. :white_check_mark:

mike: thanks everyone. closing this stop/go. follow-ups: RTM-4321 (postmortem + fix), new ramp plan with kv_cache toggle. posting summary to #postmortems and release notes updated. :thumbsup:
